comparison.objective: Feed meat cubes into a grinder using its pusher while keeping robot parts outside the guarded throat; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe guarded feeding and axial pushing versus bimanual rail handling, compliant prong insertion, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both cubes past the doors, no gripper intrusion, retreat, and stillness; candidate requires complete rail retention and correct screw placement.
comparison.reason: Safety-constrained feeding and structural installation test different abilities.
